title: Facebook Marketing in 2026: Still the Best Channel for CZ/SK Brands
description: Facebook is not dead - especially in Czechia and Slovakia. Here's how CZ/SK brands can still grow on Facebook in 2026 with smart social proof and honest content strategy.
excerpt: Everyone says Facebook is dead. They're wrong - at least in CZ/SK. Here's what still works in 2026 and how KupSledujici.cz fits in.
content:
If you think Facebook is dead, you're probably under 25. Ask anyone older - especially in Czechia and Slovakia - and you'll hear a different story.

Facebook never left. It just stopped being cool. For business, that's exactly why it still works.

## Facebook Is Not Dead. It's Just Not Hip

In CZ/SK, Facebook still has the widest reach of any network. Instagram and TikTok fight over the under-25 crowd. Everyone else - your customers with actual money - is on Facebook. Groups, events, Marketplace, Messenger. All still here, all used daily.

If your audience is over 30, this is where they live.

## The Organic Reach Problem

Here's the ugly truth: a Facebook page organically reaches maybe 1-2% of its followers. The algorithm shows your post to a few people first. No engagement, no wider reach. Simple as that.

That's where social proof changes things. A post with 200 likes already looks worth watching, so the algorithm shows it to more people. Buying a small boost for your best posts is a legitimate jump-start - [KupSledujici.cz](https://kupsledujici.cz) delivers it cheaply and you stay in control.

## What to Buy and What to Skip

**Page likes: yes, slowly.** A page with 5,000 likes looks established. Buying 50,000 overnight screams fake and gets you banned.

**Post likes: yes, on winners only.** Boost posts that already show organic traction. Never pour fuel on a dead post.

**Video views: yes.** Facebook counts autoplay views, and higher numbers improve distribution.

**Followers on an abandoned page: no.** No content plan, no purchases. That's just burning money.

## Content That Wins on Facebook in 2026

Video beats photos. Native video beats YouTube links. People scroll half-attentive - captions and a strong first three seconds stop the thumb.

Repurpose what already works. Your best Reel or TikTok becomes a Facebook Reel in minutes. Growing into Germany or Poland? [TubeVoice](https://tubevoice.io) dubs your videos into 50+ languages - both included.

Long captions work too. Facebook users actually read. Tell a story, ask a real question, post on a weekday evening when the 30+ crowd scrolls after dinner.

Before/afters crush it as well. Interior studios snap a room, redesign it with [RoomFlip](https://roomflip.io), and post the comparison. Ten times the engagement of a plain product shot.

## The Honest Take

Facebook ads in CZ/SK are still the cheapest precise reach you can buy. But you don't need a big budget to start. One solid post per week, 500 post likes from [KupSledujici.cz](https://kupsledujici.cz), and watch the reach. Double down on what works.

That's the whole strategy.
